import numpy as np, itertools, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]
Xp, yp = load("data/pilot.csv")
Xh, yh = load("data/heldout.csv")

Fp, _ = f_classif(Xp, yp); rankp = np.empty(500, int); rankp[np.argsort(-Fp)] = np.arange(500)
Fh, _ = f_classif(Xh, yh); T = np.argsort(-Fh)[:25]
print("(1) heldout F-top25 -> pilot F-rank / in pilot top50?")
print("   ", [(f"x{j+1}", int(rankp[j])+1, bool(rankp[j] < 50)) for j in T[:12]])
print("    all in pilot top-50:", bool((rankp[T] < 50).all()), " in top-100:", int((rankp[T] < 100).sum()), "/25")

# (2) pair strength among heldout top features: LR (2 feats + product) fit on heldout, in-sample AUC
def pair_auc(j, k):
    Z = np.column_stack([Xh[:, j], Xh[:, k], Xh[:, j]*Xh[:, k]])
    m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)).fit(Z, yh)
    return roc_auc_score(yh, m.decision_function(Z))

def single_auc(j, X, y):
    return roc_auc_score(y, X[:, j])

D = Xh.std(0); T0 = T[:10]
pairs = sorted(((pair_auc(j, k), j, k) for j, k in itertools.combinations(T0, 2)), reverse=True)
print("(2) top-5 pairs (fit+score on heldout, in-sample):")
for a, j, k in pairs[:5]:
    print(f"    x{j+1}&x{k+1}: {a:.3f}   (singles: {max(single_auc(j,Xh,yh),1-single_auc(j,Xh,yh)):.3f} / {max(single_auc(k,Xh,yh),1-single_auc(k,Xh,yh)):.3f})")

# (3) RF ceiling: 5-fold CV within heldout, features = heldout-top-25 (ideal feature knowledge)
